build: wp9a-s2s3: wp9a slices 2 and 3 in one build (owner decision AA3) — the declared failure set, its evaluation and acceptance; location gates and data copies (p30-deployment)
rule: Owner decision AA2 of 2026-11-26: no booking per slice; one size check at each merge (the chapters route under the cap, the script files at or under the gate, the stylesheet cap unchanged); each build reports its route bytes before and after. This file books nothing, and its name is no *-size.json, so rc44-s0-readings.mjs routeBookings does not read it.
measuredWith: node build.mjs in a checkout of each tree (dist/client-size-report.json: routes.chapters.code, routes.projects.code, scripts, buckets, css, violations). The base tree is an archive of 4349bb6 (git archive 4349bb6 AIW-V5-Local-Source, node_modules linked); the head tree is this build's. The holder of the package (the deploy-view chunk), the package's share and 'opens with records' are read from client-bundle.mjs bundleClient's metafile of each tree, as rc44-wp9a-deployment-validate.mjs S1.10 reads them (rc44-s0-readings.mjs opensWithRecords). The itemised route bytes are each changed module's bytesInOutput in the route's scripts, head less base, and the rest (the import and export lists of the route's scripts).
commands: git archive 4349bb6 AIW-V5-Local-Source | tar -x -C .aiw-local/wp9a-s2s3/base && (cd .aiw-local/wp9a-s2s3/base/AIW-V5-Local-Source && node build.mjs)
node .aiw-local/wp9a-s2s3/share.mjs (in each tree: bundleClient, the holder's modules and lists, opensWithRecords)
itemisedNote: workbenchDomainH11 is 0 on the client: the merge's branch of applyWorkbenchCommand is not in the client bundle (the server applies a merge); the hook costs the client nothing. The 38 B of lists are the exports the lazy entry now reads from route modules (simulateRuntime, runtimeEnvironmentStamp, verifierRefusal, valueFingerprint, CLASSIFICATIONS, NOT_CLASSIFIED, forwardTrace, traceGraph, retiredOf and the slot TOPOLOGY, zoneKey).

opensWithRecords.gate: The chapters-route gate is unchanged and measures opening a document that holds no package records (ruling D10). A document that holds the marker runtime.topology also loads the lazy entry of the Chapter 10 Model view (deploy-view.js) before it is first drawn.
opensWithRecords.note: The package's two filled parts add 40,350 B to what a typed document opens with. Ruling Y1 moves the packages' first-draw readers into one shared lazy entry (the lead's build S0-D10, s0-w3-bundle), which holds such a document to the route plus 160 KB; these parts are first-draw readers (checks, readings) and move with it.
